 Judgment
The petitioner has approached this Court being aggrieved by the fact that the electricity connection to a building in which he is a tenant has been disconnected on account of the fact that the owner of the building has not paid the Additional Security Deposit of Rs.16,641/-, which has to be paid on or before 08-06-2024. 
2. The learned Standing Counsel appearing for the Kerala State Electricity Board would submit that the amount of Additional Security Deposit was payable on 08-06-2024, and since it was not paid,
the electricity connection was disconnected on 06-11-2024. It is submitted that if the petitioner is willing to pay the Additional Security Deposit, the electricity connection can be restored. 
3. Heard the learned counsel appearing for the respondent- Municipality also.
4. The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner would submit that the petitioner will pay the Additional Security Deposit of Rs.16,641/-within a period of one week from today. 
5. Having heard the learned counsel for the petitioner, the learned Standing Counsel for the Kerala State Electricity Board 2024:KER:92151 and the learned counsel for the respondent-Municipality,
this writ petition will stand disposed of directing that if the petitioner pays the Additional Security Deposit of Rs.16,641/- within a period of one week from today, the electricity connection having consumer number 1156690003284 of electrical section Koorkenchery shall be restored. It is made clear that if the petitioner has any case that this amount had to be paid by the owner of the building,
it will be open to the petitioner to claim such amount from the owner of the building by initiating Niyas A vs Kerala State Electricity Board on 6 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/81664367/
2 necessary legal proceedings. In the light of the above, it is not necessary to issue any notice to the 6th respondent. It is further made clear that, if any action is being taken against the petitioner by the respondent- Municipality, the same shall be done only with notice to the petitioner. 
Writ petition ordered accordingly. 
Sd/-
